checks.rule: OS Terrain 5 is a mid-resolution digital terrain model of Great Britain.
The product is available at 5 m post spacing.
OS Terrain 5 includes 5 m interval contours.
OS Terrain 5 is produced from photogrammetry.
Ordnance Survey describes typical accuracy as greater than 2 m RMSE.
The product is updated every three months.
Grid download format includes ASCII DTM grid, with GML and Shapefile options listed for product data.
Do not treat 5 m post spacing as centimetre-level parcel elevation precision.
OS Terrain 5 remains a fallback where higher-resolution Environment Agency LIDAR is unavailable or unsuitable.
Do not mix OS Terrain 5 fallback values with 1 m LIDAR values without explicit source and uncertainty fields.
A parcel smaller than the effective terrain sampling scale requires conservative interpretation and cannot gain false precision by interpolation.
Fallback-derived height differences must retain OS Terrain 5 product identity and uncertainty rather than being labelled official high-resolution LIDAR.
